tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam rnam grol dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi sku ye shes/ /gcig bsdus dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /dbyer med khyab bdag drin chen bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gzhan skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /dal 'byor mchog thob 'khrul med bstan la zhugs/ /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol phyin par shog /rnam dag nges 'byung bdud rtsi'i do shal gyis/ /so thar khrims kyi pad+mo bskyed bsrings nas/ /bden bzhi'i lam gyi mtshar sdug yongs rdzogs pas/ /srid pa'i tsha gdung mtha' dag 'jil gyur cig /mkha' khyab 'gro kun mar shes drin dran nas/ /drin bzo'i slad du bde ba kun thob cing*/ /sdug bsngal bral phyir byams dang snying rje'i blo/ /zung 'jug lhag bsam mchog tu 'byong bar shog /de la brten nas gzhan phyir bla med pa'i/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer bas/ /sngon chad rmi lam du yang ma myong ba'i/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bzung bar shog /'gro rnams gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i lam/ /'god phyir zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos kyi/ /gtong la goms pa'i nor bu'i sprin chen las/ /'dod dgu'i gru char rtag tu 'bebs par shog /nyes spyod mtha' dag sdom pa'i pad dkar ni/ /dge chos yongs su sdud pa'i dri bsung dang*/ /gzhan phan ze'u 'bru'i mdzes pa dar babs pa'i/ /tshul gnas khrims kyi dga' tshal rgyas par shog /yul las skyes pa'i khro ba dbyings su zhi/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad la lhag par bzod/ /zab mo'i don la 'jigs med spobs pa'i mthu/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rjes su slob par shog /bsam pa go cha'i brtson 'grus rab tu brtan/ /sbyor ba rgyal sras spyod las mi g.yel zhing*/

/sems can don la ngal ba mi bsten par/ /srid pa mthar byas bar du 'jug par shog /lus sems shin sbyangs mthong chos bde bar gnas/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dbang du 'byor/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi de nyid mngon gyur pa'i/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /dang po thos pas don spyi'i gnas lugs go/ /bar du bsam pas drang nges sgro 'dogs chod/ /tha mar bsgoms pas bden gnyis zung 'jug pa'i/ /shes rab zab mo'i snang ba rgyas par shog /thabs la mkhas pas dman lam zil gnon zhing*/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis 'khor ba mi btang bar/ /smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /ye shes dam pa'i pha rol phyin par shog /phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun/ /rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnyes byas te/ /de dag rnams kyi dam chos 'dzin pa dang*/ /kun gyi 'dun sar rtag tu bsnyen par shog /de bzhin 'gro don rgya chen bsgrub pa dang*/ /sems can yongs smin 'jig rten khams kun 'jug /zhing kun yongs sbyangs theg chen lam 'jug dang*/ /spyod kun don yod theg chen bsgrub par shog /khyad par tshe gcig zung 'jug go 'phang la/ /sbyor ba'i khyad par bla med rdo rje'i theg /ji bzhin ston mkhas khyab bdag bla ma las/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i sgo gsum smin par shog /gnas skabs grub chen brgyad dang phrin las bzhi'i/ /phyi nang dbang bcu'i yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ /slob pa'-i zung 'jug myur du thob par shog /mthar thug phyag rgya'i nye rgyu la brten nas/ /slob pa min pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje'i gar/ /sku dang ye shes phrin las rab 'byams kyis/ /rang gzhan phan pa mtha' klas 'grub par shog /gzhan yang bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan/ /'gro rnams dge bcu'i spyod pas 'jig rten na/

/rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston longs spyod shog /de ltar bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtse gcig smon pa'i gnas skabs thams cad kun/ /gegs med myur ba nyid du 'grub pa y-i/ /bkra shis snang bas rtag tu mdzes gyur cig /ces pa'ang smin zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par 'og min chen po dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse'i 'og khang byang chub chen po'i spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyis bsnyen bskur cung zad bgyis pa'i tshe bcos min gyi mos pa brtan pos gsol ba btab pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang rgyal khams kyi dā ri drā gtsug lag smra ba'i nyi mas so/ /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// //
